nodes.title: The Weight of Every Choice
nodes.text: Placeholder (D2/D3): until Chapters 1–5 are written, the prologue's raid leads here. The resolver checks the endings by priority and moves straight on to the first one whose conditions hold.

nodes.title: Aether Reborn
nodes.text: Placeholder ending text (written in Phase 9). The three shards become one blade again in your hands, and no faction in Valdren has reason to fear it.

nodes.title: The Shard Tyrant
nodes.text: Placeholder ending text (written in Phase 9). You drew on the crystal's dark power once too often, and now it draws on you.

nodes.title: Ashen Dawn
nodes.text: Placeholder ending text (written in Phase 9). The Ashen Circle completes its rite, and the sun rises grey over a kingdom remade in their image.

nodes.title: Guardian of Valdren
nodes.text: Placeholder ending text (written in Phase 9). Crown and village stand together behind you, and the heartshard is sealed away under your watch.

nodes.title: The Wanderer
nodes.text: Placeholder ending text (written in Phase 9). No banner claims you and no crown thanks you. You take the road alone, the crystal's pulse fading behind you.
